TypeScript idioms live in [typescript.md](./typescript.md); Chakra/CSS 7 conventions live in [css.md](./css.md). 8 9 --- 10 11 ## Components 12 13 - **Named export** matches the folder name (e.g. `productTile/` exports `ProductTile`). 14 No default exports of anonymous functions. 15 - **Props type name** matches the component name: `ProductTileProps` for `ProductTile`, 16 `TopNavProps` for `TopNav`. 17 - **Props type placement:** 18 - _Default:_ declare the `Props` type at the top of the component file. 19 - _Move to `types.ts` in the same folder_ only when (a) the type is consumed by sibling 20 files (story, test, sub-components) **or** (b) it exceeds ~30 lines and mixes with 21 other shared types worth co-locating. 22 - The trigger is _shared consumption_, not line count alone. 23 - **JSDoc** is required on: 24 25 - Any component used by ≥2 callers (shared components — typically Tier 2 in 26 [protectedFiles.md](./protectedFiles.md)). 27 - Any exported hook. 28 - Any utility function with non-obvious behaviour. 29 30 Leaf components used by a single page don't need JSDoc — the prop type is sufficient. 31 32 - **Callback props** follow `onEventName` (e.g. `onAddToCart`, `onClose`). 33 - **Required props are non-optional;** optional props use `?` — no `| undefined` unions 34 for "I forgot to mark it optional." 35 - **Accessibility (JSX) — mechanically enforced by `.coderabbit/ast-grep-rules/`, so get 36 these right at authoring time:** 37 - Every `` needs an `alt` attribute (`alt=""` is fine for purely decorative images). 38 - Every `IconButton` (including wrapped variants like `IconButtonWithRegistration`) needs 39 an `aria-label` — it renders no visible text, so screen readers have nothing else to 40 announce. 41 - Any element with an `onClick` that isn't natively interactive (`div`, `span`, `Box`, 42 `Flex`, `Stack`, `VStack`, `HStack`, `Grid`, `Text`, and similar) needs a `role` 43 attribute at minimum — and for real keyboard operability, also `tabIndex={0}` and an 44 `onKeyDown` handler (or just use a `Button`/native interactive element instead, which 45 is almost always simpler than reimplementing keyboard behaviour). 46 47 --- 48 49 ## Composition — writing a "clean" component 50 51 Rules of thumb for when a component is doing too much and should be split, or when inline 52 state belongs in a custom hook instead. 53 54 - **Complexity / size.** A component function should stay roughly under ~150 lines and 55 avoid deep branching (rule of thumb: ~10-15 cyclomatic complexity — count independent 56 paths through the render logic, not total lines). **This is not currently ESLint-enforced** 57 — `.eslintrc.js` has no `max-lines-per-function` or `complexity` rule configured today, so 58 treat this as a self-check during authoring and something `/code-quality` should flag, not 59 something the build will fail on yet. If this keeps being a problem in practice, adding 60 those two ESLint rules is a cheap follow-up (they're built into ESLint core, no new 61 dependency needed). 62 - **Container/presentational separation.** Anything under `overrides/app/components/` 63 receives data as props — it does not call data-fetching hooks itself (SDK hooks like 64 `useCurrentBasket`/`useCurrentCustomer`/`useProduct`, or any `@salesforce/commerce-sdk-react` 65 / React Query hook). Data-fetching belongs in `overrides/app/pages/` or another container 66 component, which then passes the result down. 307

content.text:
Audit complete. All 25 files read; every finding verified against `git diff origin/develop...HEAD` before classification.

## MUST-FIX

**1. `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/` — kebab-case Zimmermann-authored folder** — NEW in this branch
`conventions.md → File naming and folder structure` ("Zimmermann-authored files and folders: `camelCase`")

`ui-kits` is not an override of a base Salesforce path — I confirmed no `ui-*` folder exists in `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/`, and `git ls-tree origin/develop:overrides/app/components/` shows it did not exist before this branch. So the kebab-case exemption for override files does not apply. Existing precedent on develop is `pageContainer/`. Should be `uiKits/`; `atoms`/`molecules` are fine as-is.

Fix cost is low today and grows with every consumer: only two files contain the literal path — `overrides/app/components/footer/index.tsx` (6 imports, lines 4-9) and the generated `.claude/registry/components.md`. The stories all use relative imports. Note Hard Rule #6 (never rename/move a shared component) means this needs an explicit human decision, not a silent fix.

## SHOULD-FIX

**2. `overrides/app/components/footer/index.tsx:50-52` — orphaned, truncated comment block**
`conventions.md → General` (no dead code introduced by this PR)
Three comment lines describing styling that moved to `footer.ts` in commit `00fb6ab`. Line 52 ends mid-sentence: `// lineHeight override: textStyles.navigation token says 'normal' (≈14.4px at 12px font), but`.

**3. `overrides/app/components/footer/index.tsx:75, 239, 323, 379, 454` — `'ZimmFooter'` repeated 5×**
`conventions.md → General → No magic numbers or strings` + DRY
Five separate `useMultiStyleConfig('ZimmFooter', {})` calls. A theme-registry key is a config key, not JSX text, so the rule's exception doesn't cover it. One `const` (or passing `styles` down) removes the drift risk against `theme/components/index.ts`.

**4. `overrides/app/components/footer/index.tsx:70-212` (`SubscribeModal`) — extract-to-hook trigger met**
`components.md → Composition → Extract-to-hook threshold`
Four `useEffect`s, three with cleanup functions (`clearTimeout`, body-overflow restore, `removeEventListener`) plus a `useCallback` keydown trap. The rule fires on *any* effect with a cleanup function. The function body is also ~143 lines, right at the ~150 guideline. `overrides/app/hooks/useZimmTextInputState.ts` already establishes the pattern in this same branch.

**5. `overrides/app/components/footer/index.tsx:233, 238` (`SubscribeSection`) — extract-to-hook trigger met**
`components.md → Composition → Extract-to-hook threshold`
`submitState` and `modalOpen` are two related `useState`s that change together — `handleModalSubmit` (246-257) sets both.

**6. `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmTextInput/index.tsx:19-41` — misattached JSDoc**
`components.md → Components → JSDoc` (documentation accuracy)
Two consecutive JSDoc blocks. The first (19-25) documents the `trailing` slot but is immediately followed by a second block (26-39) that lands on `clearable?: boolean` (40). Result: `clearable` shows the `trailing` docs' successor, and `trailing` (41) has no doc at all in editors. The `trailing` block needs to move below `clearable`.

**7. `overrides/app/hooks/useZimmTextInputState.ts:16, 49, 62` — `floated` is unconsumed; its derivation is duplicated**
`conventions.md → General → Apply DRY, KISS, and SOLID`
The hook returns `floated`, but its only consumer (`zimmTextInput/index.tsx:74`) doesn't destructure it — I grepped the whole of `overrides/` and `.storybook/`; the only other references are the hook's own test. Meanwhile `theme/components/zimmTextInput.ts:62` and `:72` each re-derive `Boolean(focused || filled)`. `zimmTextInput.test.ts:7` confirms this is leftover ("assertions moved here … when the derivation moved out"), so it's residue, not intent — three copies of one expression, one of them dead.

**8. `overrides/app/theme/components/footer.ts:265-277` — comment detached from its subject**
`conventions.md → General` (comment accuracy)
A 13-line comment about the `logo` part's mobile divider is followed at 278-280 by the `logoButton` comment and then `logoButton` itself (281). `logo` isn't defined until 293, so the divider rationale now reads as documentation for `logoButton`.

**9. `overrides/app/types/contentful.ts:81` — stale path reference (added line)**
`conventions.md → General` (comment accuracy)
`// Mirrors scripts/contentful/content-types/footer.js` — that file does not exist. `ls scripts/contentful/content-types/` contains only `shoppableImage.js`. The actual mirror is `footer/contentfulSchema.placeholder.ts`.

**10. `overrides/app/components/footer/contentfulSchema.placeholder.ts:97` — unreferenced export duplicating `types/contentful.ts`**
`conventions.md → General → DRY / resist speculative abstractions`
`export const footerContentTypes` is imported by nothing repo-wide (verified by grep excluding `node_modules`), and the file's own header says it is "NOT connected to any Contentful sync script." It hand-maintains a second description of the same schema already typed as `FooterNavLinkEntry`/`FooterNavGroupEntry`/`FooterConfigEntry` in `overrides/app/types/contentful.ts:84-130` — two copies that can drift, with no consumer to catch it. Placement is deliberate and documented (header lines 1-5), so this is about the duplication, not the location. Also note `.placeholder.` has no precedent anywhere else in the repo.

## BACKLOG

- **`overrides/app/theme/components/footer.ts:29`** — `COLOUR_HALF_INV = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5)'` is the one raw colour literal in the branch. It sits under an annotation block (17-24) whose stated scope is "Provisional **spacing/size** values … `foundation/spacing.ts` or `foundation/sizes.ts`", so a colour is covered only by implication. I confirmed there is genuinely no foundation equivalent — `colours.opacity` is grey-900-based only (`colour.ts:32-36`), no white/inverse variant. One-word comment fix, not a token change.
- **All five new atoms expose `style?: CSSProperties`** (`zimmButton:17`, `zimmLogo:6`, `zimmNavItem:23`, `zimmTextInput:42`, `zimmInputAction:17`) — a raw-CSS escape hatch at the call site that bypasses the token system. No rule in my three files forbids it; `zimmNavItem:24` already acknowledges the hierarchy ("Preferred over `style`"). Worth a deliberate decision on whether atoms should offer it at all.
- **`footer/contentfulFixture.ts:56`** — writes `'\u00A0'` inline while `footer/index.tsx:20` defines `const NBSP = '\u00A0'` next door. Same magic value expressed two ways. Constrained: the fixture can't import from `index.tsx` (that file imports the fixture — cycle), so the real fix is hoisting `NBSP` somewhere shared.
- **`footer/index.tsx:275, 277`** — `styles.subscribeSuccess` renders both the success message and the unavailable/error message. Style-key name contradicts one of its two uses. No explicit rule; naming accuracy.
- **`footer/index.tsx:163-164, 169, 184`** — `'zimm-subscribe-modal-title'` / `'zimm-subscribe-modal-consent'` each written twice (`id` + `aria-*`). Minor; a `useId` or local const removes the pairing risk.
- **`footer/index.tsx:385-389`** — `<chakra.button aria-label="Change locale" onClick={undefined}>`: a focusable control that does nothing. Annotated PLACEHOLDER, so not a token/naming breach, but it's a keyboard-reachable false affordance until the locale selector lands.
- **`overrides/app/theme/fontFace.tsx:72`** — exports `ZimmFontFace` from `fontFace.tsx`, while its sibling `zimmTokensGlobal.tsx` exports `ZimmTokensGlobal` (name matches file). No rule covers non-component-folder theme modules; flagging the inconsistency only.
- **`footer/contentfulFixture.ts` reaches production** — `FOOTER_FIXTURE` is consumed by the default export `FooterContainer` (`footer/index.tsx:574`), which is what SFCC actually renders. That's `AGENTS.md → Rules → No mocking` ("no hardcoded fixtures in production paths"), outside my three rule files. Self-documented as the HPC-034 seam at `index.tsx:555-565`, including the components.md container caveat — flagging for visibility, not as an unnoticed breach.
- **`scripts/generateRegistry.mjs:301-346`** — the new two-pass `for` loop wraps the pre-existing body without re-indenting it, so the closing braces stack at `}` / `}` (345-346) and the control flow is invisible. Outside `overrides/`, so per your instruction the overrides rules don't apply — but worth noting no tooling will catch it either: `npm run lint` globs `overrides/**/*.{ts,tsx}` and `npm run format` globs `**/*.{js,jsx}`, so `.mjs` is covered by neither.

## Verified clean (no findings in my scope)

`.storybook/main.js`, `.storybook/preview.tsx`, `_app-config/index.tsx`, `header/index.tsx`, `icons/index.tsx`, `icons/zimm.tsx`, `zimmButton/index.tsx`, `zimmIcon/index.tsx`, `zimmLogo/index.tsx`, `zimmNavItem/index.tsx`, `zimmInputAction/index.tsx`, `utils/safeHref.ts`, `theme/components/index.ts`, `theme/components/button.ts`, `theme/components/zimmNavItem.ts`, `theme/components/zimmTextInput.ts`, `types/vendor.d.ts`.

Notes on things I deliberately did **not** flag:
- **No `console.*` calls** anywhere in the audited overrides files.
- **No unannotated hardcoded design values.** Every raw `px`/`rem`/`em` literal I found is either inside a comment or a named constant with a provisional-pending-designer annotation: `zimmLogo:12-13`, `button.ts:205-207` (**PRE-EXISTING on develop**, and whitelisted by `overrideStyling.md`), `zimmNavItem.ts:11`, `zimmTextInput.ts:27`, `footer.ts:25-31`. Per your instruction #3 these are not violations.
- **`footer.ts` `parts` array is fully consistent** — I cross-checked programmatically: 34 declared parts, 34 `baseStyle` keys, 34 style keys consumed in `index.tsx`, zero mismatches in either direction.
- **All named exports match their folder names**, and all props types match their component names, across every new component.
- **`footer/index.tsx:159`** `role="presentation"` on the backdrop `<chakra.div onClick>` satisfies `components.md`'s stated minimum (a `role` attribute), and Escape-to-close provides the keyboard path, so I did not count it as a violation despite `presentation` being an odd choice for a clickable element.
- **`FooterContainer`'s `useMultiSite`/`useHistory`** are not data-fetching hooks, so `components.md → Container/presentational separation` is not breached today.
